learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge on: Linear algebra, geometry, differential geometry, differential and integral calculus, differential and partial differential equations, numerical methods and numerical algorithms.
Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate and solve problems in broad contexts, being able to integrate and work in multidisciplinary teams.
Understand the impact of engineering on the environment, the sustainable development of society and the importance of working in a professional and responsible environment.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Possess learning skills that allow continuous lifelong learning for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools into professional activities.
Know and apply basic science and technology knowledge to the practice of Industrial Engineering.
Acquire a programming language and learn to program the theoretical methods explained in class for specific problems.
Ability to solve mathematical problems in Engineering using numerical calculation techniques.

syllabus_topics: Resolution of equations and non-linear systems.
Newton-Raphson method for systems of non-linear equations.
Approximation of functions by polynomials. Numerical differentiation and integration.
Numerical resolution of ordinary differential equations.
Existence and uniqueness theorems for initial value problems for first-order differential equations.
teaching_methods: Problem solving with MATLAB in the computer lab
assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of classroom/laboratory work and two written, theoretical/practical tests with Matlab, announced in advance. A student passes if the score is 5 or greater. If a student does not achieve at least 5 points in the progressive evaluation score, they may take the global exam in the ordinary call, with the grade being that obtained in the exam. For the extraordinary call, evaluation is a global theoretical/practical exam with Matlab, passing with 5 or more points.
